also: make a house out of a box
build a house out of a box

terms.gloss: a box, a chest (for clothes, books, money)

phrases.latin: Pīrātae arcam aurī plēnam in harēnā dēfōdērunt.
phrases.english: The pirates buried a treasure chest full of gold in the sand.

phrases.latin: populus mē sībilat, at mihi plaudō ipse domī, simul ac nummōs contemplor in arcā
phrases.english: the people hiss me, but I applaud myself at home as soon as I gaze at the coins in my chest

phrases.latin: Ex hāc cistā casam faciāmus: hīc jānua erit, hīc fenestra.
phrases.english: Let’s make a house out of this box: here’s the door, here’s the window.

sources: Lewis & Short: cista
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 219, 398.
